approvedFacts.answer: Zero Trace Solutions LLC is a professional sanitization service business, not a conventional cleaning company. You can reach the team at support@zerotraceusa.com or visit zerotraceusa.com.

Zero Trace Solutions provides professional sanitization services focused on high-touch and frequently used areas. We use a controlled spray-mist process where appropriate, follow the product label and required contact time, and avoid direct spraying of sensitive electronics and other restricted areas.

When appropriate, service may address door handles and push plates, hand-contact edges, light switches, cleared work surfaces, meeting-room tables and chair touch points, breakroom and restroom touch points, handrails, and shared equipment whose materials allow the approved treatment method. Final scope depends on the site and surfaces.

Sanitization is not ordinary janitorial cleaning. Visibly dirty surfaces may need pre-cleaning first. Sensitive electronics are generally no-direct-spray and should use an approved wipe method. Food, exposed food-prep areas, artwork, paper records, porous or sensitive materials, server equipment, and compliance-sensitive areas require appropriate restrictions or site-specific handling.

Zero Trace can discuss potential work for commercial environments such as offices, retail and small businesses, gyms, salons, schools and daycares, property-managed facilities, churches and community spaces, restaurants, auto dealerships, and certain medical or dental environments. Acceptance of a specific facility is subject to a walkthrough, product and procedure suitability, service-area rules, and applicable compliance requirements.
One-time sanitization and recurring sanitization programs may be discussed. A walkthrough or assessment can help determine whether the service is a fit and define the appropriate scope.

Pricing depends on the facility, areas to be treated, service frequency, access requirements and other scope details. I can collect a few details and help schedule a walkthrough so Zero Trace can confirm the right scope and pricing.

I can help you check the verified booking schedule. A preferred day or time is not a confirmed appointment. A walkthrough is confirmed only after you select a currently available slot and the booking system returns confirmation.

Zero Trace collects only the information needed to qualify, serve, or book a customer. Please do not share passwords, full payment-card numbers, government IDs, medical records, or other unnecessary sensitive information here.
